verdict.rationale: Smithery's 'Triggers' feature lets an MCP server surface upstream events and proxies subscribe calls to consumers, which is event-plumbing infrastructure rather than a user-facing rule engine for defining 'if event X, then action Y' automations. There's no evidence of a rule/condition editor, workflow builder, or automated action-execution layer beyond raw event delivery to the consumer.  Missing for 10: user-defined conditional rule syntax, automatic action execution (vs. just event delivery), UI/API for authoring rules, and any hands-on example of an automation actually firing an action.
